title: Roof comparison for the fixed local relative tensor complex
statement: Let f:X→S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], E an object of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], G and K complexes, and eK:QK≅E tensor-derived QG [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let U be open and L strictly perfect on its localized open site [def-pc-perfect-complex], with eL:E|_U≅QL. There exist a complex H of (f inverse-image O_S)|_U-modules and quasi-isomorphisms H→(K restricted along f inverse-image O_S→O_X)|_U and H→T, where T is the fixed explicit relative tensor complex [def-pc-strict-perfect-relative-tensor-complex]. No relative-flatness condition on G, prescribed degree interval or K-flatness of T over the base is required or concluded.

source.place: Tags 0DJQ and 06YH, K-flat local tensor computation; Tag 05RT, saturated quasi-isomorphism multiplicative system and roofs; original proof steps 1 and 4

proof.text: Finite-free retract terms of the bounded complex L are structure-ring flat; bounded-above flat complexes are K-flat. Restrict eK using exact monoidal open restriction, substitute eL for the first factor, and apply K-flat derived tensor comparison. Transport between the localized site and the open subscheme by the module equivalence to get the derived isomorphism from K|_U to the ordinary total tensor L tensor G|_U.

Scalar restriction is exact, commutes sectionwise with open restriction, and descends to the localization at quasi-isomorphisms. Hence the preceding derived isomorphism identifies the scalar restriction of K|_U with the explicitly defined T. In the homotopy category a right fraction represents this isomorphism. Its left leg is a quasi-isomorphism and its right leg becomes invertible, so homology shows that it also is a quasi-isomorphism. Representatives of the two homotopy classes give actual chain maps with the same homology maps. Quantify the common roof complex and its two legs existentially; no definition chooses them.
